evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 6 semesters semesters
Study Formats: Full-time program in English
Tuition Fee: (For programs starting in September 2026) for EU students: 1,500 EUR/semester for non-EU students: 1,750 EUR/semester

notes: Deadlines: the pages give only undated application periods ("Self-funded application Autumn semester application period 1st February - 30th April") without a year and without saying they are for non-EU applicants, so no intake was output. Application channel: the how-to-apply page lists a separate "Self-funded programmes" link but its sentence does not name an online application platform or route, so the only quotable channel sentence is the Stipendium Hungaricum one; a self-financed applicant should verify the self-funded route. Documents: the pages name "secondary school leaving certificate" only as part of the entrance examination evaluation, not as a document list, so no documents fact was output.

evidence.quote: Minimum level of language proficiency (oral): B2 Minimum level of language proficiency (written): B2
Language requirements: English proficiency at CEFR level B2 or above, demonstrated by Cambridge B2 First (FCE) or C1 Advanced (CAE), IELTS 5.5 or above, TOEFL iBT 4 or above.

note.fr: Un entretien oral en ligne est requis : évaluation du diplôme d'études secondaires, de l'anglais parlé et de l'intérêt pour l'eau.
note.en: An online oral entrance examination is required: evaluation of the secondary school leaving certificate, spoken English fluency and interest in water.

evidence.quote: Entrance examination: Yes Entrance type: Oral
Evaluation of secondary school leaving certificate, through on-line meeting for ensuring the fluency in spoken English, and the interest in solving problems of water supply and water treatment
